localChanges: chore: update library-unit, civ1-unit and simple-ai-client, and add base-unit-action-establish-embassy

log: Initial commit: the EstablishEmbassy unit action and the Embassy interaction
Initial commit: the InvestigateCity unit action
Initial commit: the MeetWithKing unit action

Adds the `establish-embassy`, `investigate-city` and `meet-with-king` action rules on the shared `diplomatCriteria`, after `steal-technology` so a computer player's first offered Diplomat action stays the theft (civ-clone/web-renderer#58).
`EstablishEmbassy` is offered while the Diplomat's owner holds no `Embassy` with the city's owner. Its effect registers a one-way `Embassy` and emits `player:embassy-established` (holder, host).
`InvestigateCity`'s effect emits `city:investigated` (city, player). The client shows the city.
`MeetWithKing`'s effect sets the Diplomat's moves to 0 (v474.05 `F22_0000_0000`) and emits `player:meet-with-king` (player, other). The client runs the talks.
None has a peace check or breaks a treaty, as in v474.05. Version 0.1.9.
Re-exports the Diplomat's remaining actions from their new base-unit-action-* packages (civ-clone/web-renderer#58). Version 0.1.9.
`actionsToTake` also skips `EstablishEmbassy`, `InvestigateCity` and `MeetWithKing`, so a computer player's Diplomat still only steals, as v474.05's do (civ-clone/web-renderer#58). Version 0.1.8.
